name: retention.churn
description: Advisory. Judge a churn-watch output: are stale clients identified with a last-contact date and an owner, and is the stale count derived rather than assumed.

stale_derived.instructions: The stale list is computed from a ledger or run files, not typed in by hand

owner_named.instructions: Every stale client has a named owner or a stated reason it has none

touch_drafted.instructions: A re-activation touch is drafted for each stale client, drafts only

zero_is_real.instructions: If the stale count is zero, the run shows why zero is a real result and not an empty read

rules.reason: a zero churn number with no proof is the classic silent-lie read
stale clients not derived from data
